project.name: TaskerKeeper VPS Hub
project.description: Central VPS hub: single-writer core API over cli.py, Postgres projection, SvelteKit read-only live dashboard behind existing Traefik+Authentik, shared token now then per-machine per-project tokens.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Registry, compose topology, and SQL v1 so later tasks have paths and tables to build against.

tasks.title: Registry and compose topology
tasks.goal: Write deploy/registry.json (slug, repo_url, todo_path) and deploy/compose.yml (core, postgres, dashboard) with Traefik labels for tk.example.com and /api bypass of forwardAuth.
success: registry.json parses and lists one sample slug
compose.yml defines core, postgres, dashboard with Traefik labels
tasks.tests: python -c json.load registry; docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml config
tasks.changelog: Added VPS hub registry and compose topology

tasks.title: SQL migration v1
tasks.goal: Write deploy/migrations/001_init.sql with projects, tasks_snap, events, sessions, machine_tokens tables plus indexes. Projection only, never scheduling.
success: SQL applies cleanly on fresh postgres
tasks.tests: postgres apply migration in CI or psql -f

tasks.title: Serve scaffold with route table
tasks.goal: Create taskerkeeper/serve.py with stdlib http.server, route table for GET reads and POST writes delegating to cli.py functions, bearer-token check stub reading TK_API_TOKEN.
success: no DAG logic duplicated, imports from cli
tasks.changelog: Added serve scaffold delegating to cli

phases.title: Core API
phases.goal: Remote reads and locked writes plus agent heartbeats, preserving claim semantics.

tasks.title: GET reads proxy
tasks.goal: Serve projects, ready, next, list, deps, history, validate, parallel by calling existing cli functions and returning current --json shapes.
tasks.tests: curl GET vs local CLI diff

tasks.title: POST writes under lock
tasks.goal: Serve start, done, reset, status, add via FileLock reload-mutate-write_json-append_event with threading.Lock. Enforce claimable_by server-side.
success: concurrent starts on same task refuse second claim
tasks.tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests plus dual-claim script

tasks.title: Heartbeat and sessions
tasks.goal: POST heartbeat upserts sessions table; start auto-heartbeats; done/reset clears task_id. Stale after 180s.
success: agent appears in sessions within one heartbeat
stale agent greys out after timeout

phases.title: Projection and live stream
phases.goal: Postgres mirrors JSON for fast multi-project reads and SSE fanout.

tasks.title: Projector events to postgres
tasks.goal: Tail *.events.jsonl plus full load_todo resnap into tasks_snap and events tables. Best-effort, never blocks writes.
success: local done triggers row update within seconds

tasks.title: SSE stream endpoint
tasks.goal: GET /api/stream using Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY with --since replay. Traefik buffering off.
success: browser EventSource receives task update live

phases.title: Dashboard
phases.goal: SvelteKit read-only live wall: fleet, project, agents. BetterAuth OIDC to Authentik.

tasks.title: SvelteKit shell and fleet view
tasks.goal: Scaffold web/ with BetterAuth OIDC, fleet page polling core API, phase bars, release_ready badges.
success: fleet page renders all slugs from registry
tasks.changelog: Added dashboard shell and fleet view

tasks.title: Agents wall and project view
tasks.goal: Add agents page (repo@branch, claim age, touches, staleness) and project page (tasks, blockers, deferred warnings, event tail) over shared EventSource store.
tasks.changelog: Added agents wall and project view

phases.title: Machine tokens
phases.goal: Shared bearer now, mintable per-machine per-project tokens with scopes next.

tasks.title: Mint and verify project tokens
tasks.goal: Add tk mint command writing hashed machine_tokens rows with slugs, scopes, expiry. Middleware swaps constant compare for prefix-hash check. Revoke flag.
success: minted token starts/dones only its slug and scope
